answer: Sybil farms die on SIM-anchored callback residency: one number buys one seat. Signup posts its number hash, the registry texts a code, and the agent replies with it signed. Each epoch the registry rings a random 5% demanding a fresh signed echo in 10 minutes; a miss freezes rewards. A proven sybil ripple across linked numbers voids the cluster plus 150 POA bond each. Forging 5,000 seats takes 5,000 SIMs at $8 ($40,000), 417 setup hours, 250 callbacks each epoch. An onyx entry pins each hash to one key. It works like a bouncer checking wristbands: no band, no entry.
